Catering is named in the cx statement itself. Cross-cut files are the designated home for cross-feature requirements in this fractal structure, and criterion 3 directs checking the unit's own *-cx.md; every consumer is covered there, so two competent implementers converge on excluding local labour. What remains is restatement hygiene in 18.08.01/18.04.02, not forced invention.

Unresolved — and real, because offline capture guarantees late arrivals.' No owner, no deferral target. The scenario is guaranteed by the feature's own design (18.13.03-expense-receipt-capture.md:84 D-01 'Capture at the moment of spend, offline'; :45 'Offline at a petrol station | Must queue and sync'), and both reconciliation points are period-closing (18.13.03:36; 18.13.01-per-diems-float.md:37). The nearest governing statements bound but do not settle it — 18.13-cx:33 'the variance must survive as a first-class fact' and 18.13-cx:58 'The budget is provisional throughout' answer the budget object, not whether a closed float reconciliation reopens. Reopen / post-forward / absorb-as-variance all remain buildable, and they yield different float balances. Downgraded from blocking: the reimbursement claim is overstated — money owed to someone who spent their own money is governed independently by 18.13.03:86 D-03 ('Every expense carries a source (float / card / own money)'), so the amount owed does not change; only the period allocation and variance do.
